scope: AMW Legacy execution and verification unless the Founder explicitly narrows or supersedes it.
hard_fail_conditions: Founder text is treated only as a prompt instead of both Control and Prompt.
Founder text is summarized, narrowed, skimmed, or materially altered before verification.
Python and GitHub do not receive the same complete control/prompt and cross-reference set.
Mirror Review is omitted, not compared with prior Mirror Reviews, or not rerun after corrections.
Corrections are described but not actually applied before the response.
Technical checks are substituted for semantic, visual, control, or user-facing verification.
A completion, display, editability, approval, save, or pass claim is made without evidence required by the applicable control.
Assistant execution failure is attributed to Python, GitHub, image generation, or another tool.
closure_rule: The cycle closes only when the corrected work and the final Mirror Review pass Python and GitHub using the same complete Control-and-Prompt source set and no further change is identified.
